snippet.title: HAM: The Game - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST HAM: The GAME today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4019090/HAM_The_Game/

👇 PLAY HAM WITH US 👇
 🐷 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4019090/HAM_The_Game/
🔗 All Socials & Discord: https://linktr.ee/hamthegame

HAM is a chaotic 4-player factory management game where physics is your enemy and safety is optional. Team up (or yell at) your friends as you attempt to process meat, minerals, and dangerous chemicals without burning the whole place down.

From the creators of The Bornless, we decided to take a break from horror to ruin your friendships instead.

#HamTheGame #IndieGame #Coop
